title: Questionnaire Sketches B-D: horizon-to-horizon arc and Sun/Moon relative-size circles
description: Sighting questionnaire page (printed page 263) with blank figures for the witness to complete. "SKETCH B" is a semicircular dome labeled "Overhead", "Horizon" on both sides and "Observer's Eye" at center, for marking points a and b and tracing the object's apparent path. A blank area is labeled "SKETCH C" for drawing the object's features, and "SKETCH D" shows circles labeled "SUN" and "MOON" "in their correct relative size" with a blank "OBJECT" space between them.
